evidencia: Full abstract (corpus/merged/corpus.jsonl, not the screening sheet) describes ReMAP, a Tibet tourism-oriented personalized travel agent with self-updating and retrieval memory for factual grounding, evaluated only on real-world travel scenarios (+10.51% personalization accuracy, +12.38% itinerary pass rate); the mechanism is coupled to the smart-mobility/tourism domain, no SE-agent claim.
notes: Domain-divergent consumer travel-personalization agent, T=0; memory is instrumental to personalization, not the sole central aporte (M=1).

evidencia: Full abstract (corpus.jsonl) shows MemIndex's central contribution IS a distributed memory-management framework for LM-based multi-agent pub/sub systems ('storage, retrieval, update, and deletion operations'), with agents negotiating memory in real time; measured vs two baselines (avg. 34-56% time, 57-75% CPU, 23-76% memory reductions) - general cross-agent infra, robotics/industrial automation cited only as motivating examples for the interactive-app class, not the evaluated domain.
notes: No direct SE signal (se=0) so Q2 branch needs M=3: satisfied (memory management is the whole paper's aporte); T=1 since the mechanism is generic LLM multi-agent memory coordination, not coupled to one divergent vertical; no PDF available for this key.

evidencia: PDF section 2.2 states MARK is built/evaluated exclusively on MedMCQA, 'a large-scale multiple-choice medical question-answering dataset', across 4 experiments (GPT-3.5/GPT-4); despite abstract claims of applicability to healthcare/law/manufacturing, the only empirical evaluation is medical-domain.
notes: Real write/retrieve/forget memory mechanism (M=3) but the sole measured evaluation is medical QA - T=0 per the evaluate-what's-measured precedent (ARMAR-7 few-shot).

evidencia: PDF abstract/body: 'ranging from cognitive assistants for dementia patients to robotics' and 'we illustrate the system's working and potential using a real-world example'; the only result is Table 1 of representative Q&A examples, with 'future work should focus on... conducting large-scale evaluations' - no quantitative metric anywhere in the PDF.
notes: Consumer/embodied personal-assistant domain (dementia care, robotics) - T=0; and demo-by-example does not score E per rubric rule 7.

evidencia: Full abstract (corpus.jsonl): MemRec decouples memory management from reasoning for LLM-based agentic RECOMMENDER systems, introducing a dedicated LM_Mem to manage a collaborative memory graph; 'extensive experiments on four benchmarks' show SOTA recommendation performance - the whole study is scoped to the recommender-systems domain, no SE-agent claim.
notes: Central memory mechanism (M=3) but coupled to recommendation/collaborative-filtering domain, T=0.

evidencia: Full abstract (corpus.jsonl): STEAM organizes agent memory into atomic units with consolidation/formation mechanisms specifically for user-behavior modeling in recommender systems, evaluated on three real-world recommendation datasets against SOTA baselines - domain is user-preference/recommendation, not SE.
notes: Consolidation/forgetting mechanism is real (M=3) but the paper's whole framing and evaluation is recommender-systems personalization, T=0.

evidencia: PDF p.1 (metadata record's abstract field was empty, verified via the PDF itself): FHIR-AgentEval runs 'an ablation study of five agent configurations, varying access to... long-term memory', with the best memory configuration improving success by 9.1% over baseline on held-out clinical FHIR tasks - a genuine memory-measurement study but scoped entirely to healthcare/FHIR workflows.
notes: M=3 (measurement study whose object is memory, P2) but domain is clinical/FHIR API integration, not SE - T=0; venue Research Square is a non-peer-reviewed preprint server so selfpub=1 (does not change the T=0 call since E=1, no P3 trap).

evidencia: Full abstract (corpus.jsonl): Shopping Companion introduces a long-term memory benchmark over 1.2 million e-commerce products and a unified framework jointly tackling memory retrieval and shopping assistance, evaluated with GPT-5 (<70% success) - the whole study is scoped to e-commerce shopping tasks, no SE-agent evidence.
notes: Memory mechanism is central and measured (M=3, E=1) but the domain is e-commerce/shopping personalization, T=0.

evidencia: Full abstract (corpus.jsonl): MemReranker is a reranking model family for 'agent memory systems' generally (0.6B/4B, distilled from Qwen3-Reranker), measured on 'the memory retrieval benchmark' (0.737 MAP) plus explicit cross-domain generalization tests on 'finance and healthcare vertical-domain benchmarks' - the mechanism and its evaluation are domain-agnostic infrastructure for agent memory retrieval, not one divergent vertical.
notes: No direct SE signal (se=0) so Q2 branch needs M=3: satisfied (reranking-for-memory-retrieval is the entire contribution); T=1 because cross-domain transfer is empirically demonstrated, not merely claimed.

evidencia: Full abstract (corpus.jsonl): MedMemoryBench is a benchmark of ~2,000 sessions/16,000 turns of synthetic clinical trajectories for 'personalized healthcare agents', formalizing 'memory saturation' via an evaluate-while-constructing protocol - a memory-measurement study (M=3, P2) but entirely scoped to production medical-agent deployment, not SE.
notes: Measurement study whose object is memory (M=3) but healthcare-coupled throughout dataset/eval design, T=0.

evidencia: PDF (10pp, Reproducibility section p.9-10, code at github.com/yhkkk1234/ai-soul-memory-system): the anchor-aware memory compressor is measured in a 50-round live conversation test achieving 100% non-anchor discard while preserving 54-75% of anchor-critical messages with 'zero anchor drift'; the mechanism (behavioral-consistency-preserving compression) is generic to any conversational LLM agent, not coupled to one divergent domain.
notes: Zenodo preprint so selfpub=1, but E=1 (real measured compressor results, GPU/code reproducibility section) so P3 auto-GRIS does not trigger; T=1 since domain-agnostic agent-memory compression, no SE signal so Q2 branch needs M=3: satisfied.
